# JustMate

> JustMate ("Meet for real") is an app that gets lonely people out of the door and in front of someone compatible: a small plan near you with one person, or a walk to someone nearby right now. No faces, no chat. Built by a team at HackYeah 2026 (Kraków).

How it works: you build a faceless profile once (Mate or Date, interests, a few short questions). Plan proposes one concrete plan nearby with a compatible person and you only say yes. Now pings two compatible people who are already out, and a compass walks them to each other. Others see only a vibe badge, never a photo, and the map shows zones, never a person's position.
